title: Fixed Twin Cam and Open Pipe Coupler
description: One complete newly authored static twin-cam pipe-coupler display. A thick through-bored female sleeve has two actual opposed side windows bounded by continuous front and rear annular rings. Two whole bronze eccentric-cam and long-lever bodies rotate only in their declared fixed display pose between paired exterior support ears and real vertical pins. A separate complete open male adaptor partly enters the sleeve, with a recessed circumferential exterior seat and a fully open barb-profile tail. A low base and sleeve saddle provide the display support. Unlike the old paired cam cleat or open wafer-disc valve, this complete relation surrounds a longitudinal male/female passage, uses external lateral cam levers and contains no closure disc, radial collet fingers or rope jaws. All whole geometry newly authored; no old meshes imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres Z-up and horizontal whole-envelope centred ground origin. Static exterior only: no seal, pressure rating, fit, hose compatibility, locking, rotation, pipe connection, flow, transport or safety claim; no rig or interaction.
